summary: Sets up a Direct3D texture/render-state binding for a surface. Selects between a default-texture path and a descriptor-driven path based on the flag dword a2[6] (bit 0x40000). The descriptor path loads either a file/stream-backed source a2[3] or locks a surface object a2[5] (via vtable slot 60), then binds it through the D3D device wrapper this[1088] (this+0x1100) using the device method at vtable offset 124; the flag 0x200000 selects a stream-handle variant. Stores the load result in this+0x0, and when a3 is non-null builds a 6-word vector from a2[7]/a2[8] and applies it through the device method at vtable offset 160. Returns a3 when present, otherwise the last result.

local_names.a2: texture/surface descriptor object (flag dword at index 6, source at index 3, surface at index 5)
local_names.this[1088]: D3D device wrapper pointer at this+0x1100
local_names.v16: local 6-word transform vector applied via device vtable slot 160

operations.description: Entry branch: when a2 is null, or a2 is non-null but its flag dword a2[6] has bit 0x40000 clear, take the default-texture path using this[1354]+12 and this[1355]+12; otherwise walk the descriptor a2.
Default path: invoke the D3D device method at vtable offset 124 on the wrapper this[1088] (this+0x1100) with the two default parameters *(this[1354]+12) and *(this[1355]+12).
Descriptor path: when a2[3] is non-null the source is file/stream-backed and is loaded directly; when null, a2[5] is a surface object that must be locked first.
Flag 0x200000 in a2[6] selects the stream-handle variant of the load in both the a2[3] and a2[5] branches.
File load, stream variant: call device vtable slot 124 (this[1088], a2[3], 0).
File load, non-stream variant: when a2[1] is non-null and *(a2[1]+12) is non-zero use that identifier; otherwise fall back to *(this[1355]+12).
File load: call device vtable slot 124 (this[1088], a2[3], identifier) where identifier is *(a2[1]+12) or *(this[1355]+12).
Surface path: when a2[5] is null, jump to LABEL_19 and skip the result write; otherwise proceed to lock and load the surface.
Surface lock, stream variant: call device vtable slot 124 (this[1088], 0, 0).
Surface lock, non-stream variant: write *this = (surface vtable slot 60)(a2[5], 0, &a2) to lock the surface object.
Surface data load: call device vtable slot 124 (this[1088], a2, identifier) with identifier *(a2[1]+12) or *(this[1355]+12), then release the surface through its vtable slot 8.
Store the load result into this+0x0: *this = v7 (the render handle returned by the D3D load).
Transform step: when a3 is non-null, build a 6-word vector and apply it as the current transform.
Build the transform vector v16: v16[0]=0, v16[1]=0, v16[2]=a2[7], v16[3]=a2[8], v16[4]=0, v16[5]=1065353216 (identity-scaled component).
Apply the transform: result = device vtable slot 160 (this[1088], v16) and store *this = result.
Return result (a3 when non-null, otherwise the last load result); on the frame path, called by F_2DSurfaceBlitFill, sub_553700 and sub_55CC20.
